note: Acquisition tiers for crafting ingredients, used by tools/validate.mjs and tools/catalog.mjs to check that the recipe cost curve matches the rarity curve. Build-time only; not shipped. An item not listed here is tier 0 — something a new player can get in their first hour.

tiers.label: deep overworld
tiers.why: needs a mine, a biome hunt, or a mob that does not spawn everywhere

tiers.label: nether, ocean monument or trial chamber
tiers.why: needs a dimension change or a generated structure

tiers.label: end, ancient city or deep nether
tiers.why: needs the End, an ancient city, or ancient debris

tiers.label: boss or raid
tiers.why: needs a dragon, a wither or an evoker put down

expected.note: The lowest ingredient tier a recipe of each rarity should require. A recipe whose rarest ingredient falls below its floor is cheaper than its tier implies; one far above is a wall.
